name: XAUUSD_REGIME_SWITCH_ENGINE

entry_rules.hypothesis: Regime-switching multi-strategy. Classify market state on M15 (RANGE, TREND_UP, TREND_DOWN, UNSURE, ABNORMAL_VOL via ADX + EMA + ATR percentile), then route M5 entries to the appropriate sub-strategy: trend-following (pullback in trend direction) for TREND regimes, mean-reversion (RSI extremes + range bounce) for RANGE, and WAIT for UNSURE/ABNORMAL. The regime classifier is the gate, not a predictor.

regime_classification.trend_up: EMA34 > EMA89 AND ADX >= adx_strong -> trend-following buy
regime_classification.trend_down: EMA34 < EMA89 AND ADX >= adx_strong -> trend-following sell
regime_classification.unsure: ADX between adx_weak and adx_strong -> WAIT

strategy_routing.TREND_UP: trend_signal: pullback to EMA + continuation candle
strategy_routing.TREND_DOWN: trend_signal: pullback to EMA + continuation candle
strategy_routing.RANGE: range_signal: RSI extremes + range bounce + tight stop

stop.description: ATR-based for trend, tight ATR for range mean-reversion

description: V10: Regime-Switching Multi-Strategy Engine. Classifies M15 market regime (5 states), then routes M5 entries to trend-following or mean-reversion sub-strategies. The most sophisticated hypothesis yet — but the complexity did not help; all sub-strategies lose.

research_results.hypothesis: A regime-switching approach that routes to different sub-strategies based on market state will find edge where single-strategy approaches fail.

grid_search_train.result: ALL configs lose. Best TRAIN net=-693.7 pips, PF=0.03

validation.conclusion: Validation has 0% win rate — complete failure to generalize

regime_breakdown.RANGE: 15,229 bars (32.1%) — 0 BUY signals, 0 SELL signals (range mean-reversion sub-strategy produces nothing)
regime_breakdown.TREND_UP: 10,315 bars (21.8%) — 389 buys, 60 sells (trend sub-strategy fires in uptrend, losses)
regime_breakdown.TREND_DOWN: 8,381 bars (17.7%) — 42 buys, 548 sells (most activity in downtrend, all losing)

research_results.root_cause: The regime router is fundamentally broken by construction. The range sub-strategy (RSI extremes + range bounce) produces ZERO signals — the RANGE regime classification and the RSI extreme conditions never co-occur on this data. Most signals come from TREND_DOWN (548 sells), which all lose. The multi-strategy complexity did not help — each sub-strategy inherits the same fundamental problem: no edge on M5/XAUUSD gold after costs.
research_results.conclusion: NO EDGE. 864-parameter grid, best config PF=0.03, 11% win rate in-sample, 0% in validation. Walk-forward shows consistent losses across all 6 windows. Monte Carlo: 100% ruin probability. The regime-switching meta-strategy produces fewer and worse signals than the simpler strategies. REJECTED.

notes: Research script: research/v10_regime_switch.py — no MT5 writes, no live trading, no fabrication. All numbers computed from db/trading.db (XAUUSD M15: 47398 bars, M5: 35797 bars).
